parts.text: Coach brought one bag filled with basketballs to practice and dumped them all out onto the gym floor before practice began.
After the practice time was over, he asked Jordan, Jason, and Jeffrey to pick up the balls and carry them over to the bag.
The three boys picked up and carried all of the balls in one trip.
Jordan carried twice as many balls as Jason, and Jason carried twice as many balls as Jeffrey.
If the total number of balls the coach brought to practice was 7, how many balls had Jason picked up and carried?

parts.text: James gets some emails a day.
20% of those emails don't require any response.
He responds to the rest of them.
If he respond to 320 emails in a 5 day work week, how many emails does he receive every work day?

parts.text: Stephen borrowed $300 from his sister and promised to return it with an additional 2% of the money he owed.
For 11 months Stephen will give his sister the same amount per month and the remaining amount, including the interest, will be paid on the twelfth month.
Stephen pays $31 in the twelfth month.
How much does Stehphen give to his sister per month?

parts.text: Terri is knitting a sweater with two sleeves, a collar, and a decorative rosette.
The body of the sweater takes 900 stitches to complete, the collar takes a tenth of that number of stitches, and the rosette takes twice as many as the collar.
How many stitches does the whole sweater need?

parts.text: Out of the 200 teachers on the school basketball court, 70% are history teachers.
If the rest of the teachers on the court are math teachers, and each teacher sleeps for 8 hours a day, calculate the total time the math teachers collectively spend sleeping in one day.
